blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A bill that seeks to strengthen the Safe Spaces Act by defining and penalizing other forms of sexual harassment and abuse, like the practice of grooming, has been approved by the House of Representatives on third and final reading. During the session on Tuesday, House Bill (HB) No. 11264 which contains proposed amendments to Republic Act No. 11313 or the Safe Spaces Act was approved after 200 lawmakers in favor of the measure, with only two voting in the negative and one abstaining.
